description: This file defines the MessageSerializer class responsible for serializing and deserializing messaging messages within the Orleans runtime framework. It manages framing, encoding, decoding, and reading/writing various message components, including headers, body, and request context, utilizing codecs and sessions.

classes.name: MessageSerializer
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing and deserializing messages in the Orleans messaging system.

classes.name: MessageBufferWriter
classes.description: A wrapper around PrefixingBufferWriter implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for message serialization.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read a message from a ReadOnlySequence<byte>, returning framing details and the message if complete.

methods.name: ReadBodyObject
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the body object from the message body.

methods.name: GetRawCodec
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ResponseCodec for a given response type.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a message into a PipeWriter, including headers and body.

methods.name: ThrowIfLengthsInvalid
methods.description: Checks if header and body lengths are within valid bounds, throws if invalid.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes message headers and components into a writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes message headers and components from a reader.

methods.name: ReadCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Reads list of GrainAddressCacheUpdate from the reader.

methods.name: WriteCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Writes list of GrainAddressCacheUpdate to the writer.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string from the reader, handling null and empty cases.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Writes a string to the writer, handling null values.

methods.name: WriteRequestContext
methods.description: Writes the request context dictionary to the writer.

methods.name: ReadRequestContext
methods.description: Reads a request context dictionary from the reader.

methods.name: ReadGrainId
methods.description: Reads a GrainId from the reader.

methods.name: WriteGrainId
methods.description: Writes a GrainId to the writer.
